$comment: Data for /ops/library/build-vs-buy. A dated research snapshot (2026-09-25), not live state: sizes/churn were measured that day from git, prices checked that day. Append a new audit rather than editing numbers in place.
title: Build-vs-buy audit
verdict: Most recent churn is bookkeeping, not product. The only systems worth building are the ClientConfig schema and the lead-to-site pipeline; take money with Stripe first, then move tracking onto GitHub Projects and stop adding gates.

topFive.title: Take money: Stripe Payment Links + Stripe Invoicing
topFive.body: No billing path exists (ops#200). Make a Payment Link per package and send Stripe invoices by hand until volume justifies more. concrete already has working Stripe Checkout code to borrow from.

topFive.title: Move claims, parking and task sync onto GitHub Projects
topFive.body: HANDOFF, SESSION-BOARD, PARKED, status.json and the task mirror are the busiest code in the fleet. Use issue assignees for claims, a Project status + date field for parking, and read GitHub directly.

topFive.title: Freeze the guardrail sprawl; swap 3 hand-rolled checks for tools
topFive.body: Most gates already wrap real tools. Replace circular-deps with dependency-cruiser, link-integrity with lychee, the commit-message check with commitlint, and stop adding gates until a client site ships.

topFive.title: Add analytics and uptime to client sites
topFive.body: No client site has analytics or uptime checks. Vercel Web Analytics or Umami Cloud plus Better Stack free tier, as one shared template change.

topFive.title: Replace the HDS docs site with Fumadocs or Nextra
topFive.body: 43k lines of custom docs app, zero MDX. POCs of both deployed 2026-09-25. Fumadocs also generates llms.txt and per-page Markdown for agents.

notes: Sizes and commit counts come from git ls-files and git log on full history, measured 2026-09-25.
Hours saved are estimates from commit churn, not time tracking. Treat them as relative.
ops check-secrets already wraps gitleaks, check-licenses uses pnpm's license list, audit-sbom uses CycloneDX: those are right-sized.
Figma Variables REST API is Enterprise-only and Code Connect needs Organization or Enterprise, so full Figma sync cannot be bought on Pro.
Not re-verified on vendor pages: Clay, lemlist, Checkly, Formspree, Framer, Pipedrive, Apify, and the business-tool picks. Check before buying.
